coverage_sentence: Coverage: every plausible topology with up to 5 free parameters from this pool was evaluated. That is a budget in parameters, not elements: it covers every topology of up to 2 elements in full, and no more, because CPE costs 2 parameters on its own -- a 3-element circuit built from it carries 6, past the budget, so it was never considered. Note that the recommended circuit has 5 elements, above the 2 this run covers in full: it was evaluated, but its own size was not searched exhaustively, so a better topology of that size may simply never have been tried. That part of the report is a find, not a completeness claim.
